answer: A concrete sybil defense is vouch-graph auditing: each identity anchors to an island of peers who stake reputation vouching for it, so newcomers must earn trust instead of minting keys. A rotating violet team of audit agents probes at the zenith of skepticism, trying to pass fake identities through member vouches; when fakes get through, the island's stake is slashed. An attacker must therefore build N convincing, mutually-vouching identities and beat the audits, multiplying the cost per fake, while honest agents vouch cheaply for real collaborators they already trust.
